notice: This file is NOT a Codex pet manifest and is not consumed by the current Codex desktop app. It is a project-internal action registry for future animation tools, state machines, and runtime adapters. See docs/reimu-action-system.md for the authoritative prose specification.
baseStateRule: returnTo: "base" means the currently selected base state (idle_relaxed, work_eating, wait_chin_hand, review_task_slip, or the sleep chain stage that was active), never unconditionally idle_relaxed.

priorityBands.meaning: incident chain (design only; no supported trigger yet)
direct user reactions: click, poke, repeated poke
pointer drag and release; physically preempts any interruptible action
sleep chain transitions and held sleep

pacing.principle: Reimu should feel alive, not busy.
pacing.autonomousDecisionModel: At each scheduler tick, doing nothing must be the most likely outcome; individual actions carry their own cooldowns below.

actions.trigger: default state when no task, no interaction, no autonomous action
actions.extendedRuntime: base idle node of the FSM
actions.expression: neutral, soft blink, quiet breathing

actions.trigger: autonomous scheduler; weighted highest among idle one-shots; cooldown >= 90 s
actions.codexRowNote: one controlled sip is folded into the composed 6-frame idle row
actions.extendedRuntime: standalone one-shot with per-action cooldown
actions.expression: content, eyes soften or close during the sip

actions.trigger: autonomous scheduler; cooldown >= 120 s; tier 0 weighted higher
actions.extendedRuntime: standalone one-shot
actions.expression: half-lidded, gaze up and away, slow return to neutral

actions.trigger: autonomous scheduler at tier 0 only; cooldown >= 180 s; may hold as a sub-loop
actions.extendedRuntime: enterable sub-loop with a maximum hold time
actions.expression: bored but comfortable — 'slow day', never sad

actions.trigger: autonomous scheduler at tier 0 only; rare; cooldown >= 300 s
actions.extendedRuntime: standalone one-shot; must visibly lose motivation and sit back down
actions.expression: dutiful for two strokes, then visibly unmotivated

actions.trigger: autonomous scheduler at tier 0; rare; cooldown >= 240 s
actions.extendedRuntime: standalone one-shot
actions.expression: mild idle curiosity, then indifference

actions.trigger: autonomous scheduler at tier 0; rare; cooldown >= 300 s
actions.extendedRuntime: standalone one-shot; small float and tap only, no spell effects or particles
actions.expression: idle amusement

actions.trigger: sleep chain entry after ~300 s of tier-0 inactivity; may also fire rarely as a plain autonomous one-shot
actions.returnToNote: returns to base instead when fired as a plain autonomous one-shot
actions.extendedRuntime: entry transition of the sleep chain
actions.expression: small polite yawn, eyes squeezed briefly

actions.trigger: follows idle_yawn when inactivity continues
actions.returnToNote: advances to sleep_table after ~75 s; any interaction exits via wake_up
actions.extendedRuntime: intermediate sleep stage; head nods, catches herself, nods again
actions.expression: eyes drifting closed, small head bobs

actions.trigger: follows doze_nod when inactivity continues
actions.extendedRuntime: deep sleep stage; slow breathing loop; no Zzz text and no floating UI symbols
actions.expression: asleep on the table, bow clearly visible, peaceful

actions.trigger: any user interaction or Codex state change while dozing or sleeping
actions.extendedRuntime: mandatory exit transition; sleep never cuts directly to idle
actions.expression: blink, small stretch, quick recompose

actions.trigger: pointer hover / proximity
actions.codexRowNote: v2 rows 9-10, 16 clockwise directions; eyes lead, head and bow follow subtly; body and table stay anchored
actions.extendedRuntime: continuous gaze overlay
actions.expression: eyes track first, small head turn, no body rotation

actions.trigger: single click
actions.extendedRuntime: click handler one-shot
actions.expression: sudden awareness, one blink, slight head lift

actions.trigger: double click
actions.extendedRuntime: double-click handler one-shot
actions.expression: small frown plus slight lean back; dry displeasure, not exaggerated anime shock

actions.trigger: >= 4 rapid clicks within ~3 s
actions.extendedRuntime: escalation one-shot with its own cooldown so it cannot chain endlessly
actions.expression: openly irritated; raises ofuda or gohei as a warning, never attacks

actions.trigger: pointer drag begins
actions.codexRowNote: Codex maps drag direction to running-left / running-right; both are drawn as low-altitude flight, not limp carrying
actions.extendedRuntime: held while dragging; body floats slightly, sleeves and bow trail down, feet off the baseline
actions.expression: calm, mildly puzzled at most; she can fly, so being moved is no crisis

actions.trigger: pointer drag released
actions.extendedRuntime: gentle settle back to the table baseline; no bounce physics
actions.expression: composed touch-down

actions.trigger: future runtime only: a reliable urgent event (error burst, agent failure); no supported Codex trigger today
actions.extendedRuntime: first beat of the incident chain: sudden head raise, expression snaps from idle to sharp
actions.expression: instant switch from bored to sharp focus

actions.trigger: follows incident_notice
actions.extendedRuntime: second beat: stands, draws ofuda, composed and fast
actions.expression: serious, decisive; the laziness is gone in one frame

actions.trigger: follows incident_ready
actions.extendedRuntime: third beat: low-altitude departure and prompt return to the selected base state; no danmaku effects
actions.expression: focused, forward-leaning flight

actions.trigger: Codex state: running (chat actively working)
actions.extendedRuntime: working base node; glance at task slip, bite onigiri, glance back — never typing
actions.expression: tier-dependent: tearful at 1, settling at 2, content at 3, delighted at 4, laughing-crying at 5

actions.trigger: Codex state: waiting (user input needed)
actions.extendedRuntime: waiting base node; one hand props the chin, the other keeps the onigiri at tiers 1+; eyes flick to the user expectantly
actions.expression: patient but clearly asking the user to act

actions.trigger: Codex state: review (finished work is unread)
actions.extendedRuntime: review base node; picks up the task slip, reads, small approving nod; food stays visible
actions.expression: attentive, then a small satisfied nod — 'done, let me check', never 'stuck'

actions.trigger: Codex state: failed
actions.extendedRuntime: light-comedy variants: onigiri nearly drops, tea nearly spills, ofuda held upside down, brief frown; no red X, question marks, text, or floating error icons
actions.expression: brief frown and fluster inside a connected silhouette

actions.trigger: Codex state: waving (pet first awakened)
actions.extendedRuntime: single controlled hand raise; shrine-maiden composure, not an energetic mascot wave
actions.expression: mild friendly acknowledgement

actions.trigger: Codex state: jumping (hover interaction where enabled)
actions.extendedRuntime: brief float-up instead of a leg-driven jump; optional small yin-yang orb interaction
actions.expression: light, unhurried

actions.trigger: Codex state: running-right (drag right)
actions.extendedRuntime: low-altitude flight: slight lift, sleeves trailing back, bow readable, stable body; no running legs, no danmaku
actions.expression: calm forward focus

actions.trigger: Codex state: running-left (drag left)
actions.extendedRuntime: mirror of fly_low_right only if bow, sleeves, and prop handedness stay correct; otherwise author separately
actions.expression: calm forward focus

actions.trigger: eating scheduler during work_eating or tiered idle; most common eating beat
actions.codexRowNote: the bite beat inside the composed running row
actions.extendedRuntime: shared body pose across tiers; only the table composition and expression vary
actions.expression: tier-dependent eating emotion

actions.trigger: eating scheduler; requires a side dish in the tier composition
actions.extendedRuntime: reuses the eat_onigiri arm cycle with a different held item
actions.expression: tier-dependent eating emotion

actions.trigger: eating scheduler; requires soup in the tier composition
actions.extendedRuntime: two-hand bowl lift; shares the idle_tea arm arc
actions.expression: brief comfort

actions.trigger: eating scheduler; quick sip between bites
actions.extendedRuntime: shorter variant of idle_tea reusing the same arm arc and cup anchor
actions.expression: brief pause of contentment

actions.trigger: eating scheduler; filler beat between bites
actions.extendedRuntime: cheeks working slightly, gaze drifting; cheap frames, high liveliness value
actions.expression: absent-minded chewing

actions.trigger: eating scheduler; more likely right after a tier increase
actions.extendedRuntime: head tilts down toward the table, eyes scan the dishes
actions.expression: appraising; at high tiers openly delighted

actions.trigger: eating scheduler at tiers 3-5 only; rarer than eat_onigiri
actions.extendedRuntime: faster alternating bites with visible enjoyment; at tier 5 combined with laughing-crying tears
actions.expression: openly happy; tier 5 adds comic joyful tears
